{{Quote|Peacetime or no peacetime, the Corellian Sector can be a tricky piece of space.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="AaC">''[[Ambush at Corellia]]''</ref>}}
The '''Corellian sector''', also known as the '''Corellia sector''', was a group of [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]] region. Twenty nine systems made up the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] and the primary worlds of the sector, such as [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], [[Altawar]], and [[Duro/Legends|Duro]], were counted amongst the influential [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].

==Description==
{{Quote|Well, the Corellian Sector is made up of a couple of dozen star systems, but the most ''important'' star system in the sector is the Corellian star system. And the most important ''planet'' in the Corellian star ''system'' in the Corellian ''Sector'' is Corellia, and the capital city is Coronet.|Han Solo|<ref name="AaC" />}}
An ancient and advanced group of worlds, the Corellian sector was one of the earliest interstellar communities, developing it into one of the most industrialized sectors along with the [[Kuat sector/Legends|Kuat sector]] and [[Humbarine sector/Legends|Humbarine sector]]. This industry and interconnectivity spawned many important trade clusters and powerful corporations. The sector was the hub of the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] and the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]]. Corellia, the ostensible sector capital, was so predominant within the sector, that the terms "Corellian system" and "Corellian sector" were often used synonymously or erroneously. The other systems in the sector were referred to as the [[Outlier systems]].

==History==
{{Quote|And then the war itself came. And the whole Corellian Sector might as well have built a wall around itself. The Emperor's Corellian government got scared. Not just scared of the Rebellion, but scared of everyone. They decided the safest thing to do was not to trust anyone at all. They decided they didn't want the traders. In fact, they didn't want any outsiders.|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]|<ref name="AaC" />}}
[[File:Drall.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Drall (planet)|Drall]], one of the worlds of the Corellian system]]
During the later years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], of which several planets in the sector were founding members, the Corellian sector was represented in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] by [[Com Fordox]] and later by [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]], who despite his efforts to seal the sector, was unable to shield it from the bloodshed of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

With the foundation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the sector was forced under the hand of Coruscant once again, with [[Fliry Vorru]] as its [[Moff/Legends|Moff]]. Its shipyards were commandeered by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Starfleet]], its economy interrupted by [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] wide military industrial complex and its young drafted into the military. During this time so many beings fled the sector to become [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], criminals, or [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] that they almost became synonymous with the sector name. Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], a large number of Imperials streamed into the Sector, giving new authority to pro-Imperial factions.

Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Corellian sector was among the first sectors to throw off the Empire.<ref name="RECG" /> Thus, the sector seized the chance for independence, and the Corellian sector became intensely introverted and isolationist during the period following the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Doman Beruss (Corellian)|Doman Beruss]] represented expatriates of the sector on the [[New Republic Provisional Council]]. Once again, efforts to isolate itself failed. The sector was the battle ground first for the [[Imperial Civil War|internecine war]] between [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admirals]] [[Josef Grunger]] and [[Danetta Pitta]] that ended in the climactic [[Battle of Tralus (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Tralus]], and then for [[Thrackan Sal-Solo]]'s [[Corellian Crisis|attempted secession]] of the sector from the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Eventually, the Corellian sector opened up to the New Republic at the [[Corellian Trade Summit]], but maintained many stringent limitations.

Membership in the New Republic brought a new period of cooperation. The [[Duro system/Legends|Duro system]], lumped together with the Corellian sector by the Empire, was spun off and named as the seat of the restored [[Duro sector/Legends|Duro sector]]. The worlds of the Sector worked together to equip, manage and man the [[Corellian Defense Force/Legends|Corellian Defense Force]], which included the [[Corellian Defense Forces Space Service|Space Defense Service's]] [[Corellian Sector Fleet]]. They were also served by a sectorwide independent news network, the [[Corellian Sector Newsfeed]]. During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], [[Chelch Dravvad]] represented the sector in the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]].

Starting around [[39 ABY]], the sector once more attempted to assert its independence during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]].

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Wikipedia:Personal computer|PC]] game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] incorrectly places [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]] in the Corellian sector.
